description: Read the structural analysis of one court decision, starting generation when there is none yet. The analysis is generated by stella, not by the court: show its aiDisclosure text to the user beside anything taken from it. Returns status done with the stored analysis and aiDisclosure, generating while a run is in flight (poll until it is done), or error with a code: decision_not_found, document_unparseable, language_unsupported, analysis_disabled or source_restricted when no analysis can be made; answer_incomplete, timed_out, provider_refused, provider_unavailable or failed when the last run failed, with key naming whose AI key it used (the organization's own, or the platform's). A failed run answers callers using the same key for 15 minutes; within that window a call passing retry=true starts a new run, and after it the next call starts one on its own. When the provider named a later time to retry, the failure carries it as retryAt (ISO 8601) and answers every call, retry=true included, until then. Generation runs in the background and a call made while one is already running does not start a second.
